narration: Trouble followed Oscar. A torpedo struck his next ship, then the Ark Royal went down too.

full.title: ONE CAT, THREE SHIPS
full.brief: Chain of the three ships the cat survived: Bismarck sunk (May 1941), HMS Cossack torpedoed (Oct 1941), HMS Ark Royal torpedoed (Nov 1941); a small cat marker moves from ship to ship.
